guideline: Lenders must disclose the Annual Percentage Rate (APR) including all fees and charges before sanctioning any loan.
explanation_hi: ब्याज दर 24% से अधिक है। यह RBI के नियमों के विरुद्ध है।
explanation_en: Interest rate exceeds 24% per annum. This violates RBI Fair Practices guidelines.

guideline: Lenders cannot deduct fees, insurance premiums or any charges upfront from the disbursed loan principal.
explanation_hi: ऋण की राशि में से पहले ही कटौती की जा रही है। यह अनुचित प्रथा है।
explanation_en: Upfront fee deduction from loan principal is an unfair practice per RBI guidelines.

guideline: Lenders cannot take blank signed cheques or blank signed documents as security for a loan.
explanation_hi: खाली चेक लेना गैर-कानूनी है। यह ऋणदाता को असीमित राशि निकालने का अधिकार देता है।
explanation_en: Taking blank signed cheques as loan security is prohibited. It gives lender unchecked access to funds.

guideline: Lenders cannot seize or sell collateral (including agricultural land) without proper legal proceedings.
explanation_hi: अदालती आदेश के बिना संपत्ति जब्त करने की शर्त गैर-कानूनी है।
explanation_en: Seizure of property without court proceedings is illegal under Indian law.

guideline: All loan interest rates must be in simple annual percentage terms. Compound interest must be explicitly disclosed and agreed upon.
explanation_hi: चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज का स्पष्ट उल्लेख न होने पर यह अनुचित प्रथा मानी जाती है।
explanation_en: Undisclosed compound interest is an unfair lending practice under RBI regulations.
